@@U02092@@
let us kneel, let us kneel and call on the saints! You see? Do you see, here, under these steps? Here? Hell seethes! Hell’s cauldron’s boiling! The Evil One, with rage in his voice, makes a terrible din!

@@U02094@@
(Loudly.)

@@U02095@@
格蕾琴! 格蕾琴!

@@U02097@@
(Listening.)

@@U02098@@
That was my lover's voice!

@@U02099@@
(She jumps up. The chains fall from her.)

@@U02100@@
Where is he? I heard him call to me. I’m free! No one can stop me! I'll fly to him, his arms! Hold him so tight! He called “格蕾琴!” There on the threshold! And through all the howling and clanking of Hell, through the furious rage of devilish mockery, I recognized his dear, sweet voice.

@@U02102@@
It’s me!

@@U02104@@
You! Oh, say it again, again!
translation:
@@U02092@@
让我们跪下，让我们跪下，呼求圣徒！你看？您看到这里的这些步骤了吗？这里？地狱沸腾！地狱的大锅沸腾了！恶人的声音中充满了愤怒，发出了可怕的喧嚣！

@@U02094@@
（大声。）

@@U02095@@
格蕾琴！ 格蕾琴！

@@U02097@@
（听着。）

@@U02098@@
那是我爱人的声音！

@@U02099@@
（她跳了起来。锁链从她身上掉下来。）

@@U02100@@
他在哪儿？我听到他叫我。我有空了！没有人能阻止我！我要飞向他，他的怀抱！把他抱得这么紧！他喊“格蕾琴！”就在门槛上！穿过地狱的嚎叫声和叮叮当当声，穿过恶魔般的嘲笑的狂怒，我认出了他亲爱的、甜美的声音。

@@U02102@@
是我！

@@U02104@@
你！哦，再说一遍，再说一遍！
